summary: Nouveau Monde Graphite Inc. filed a Report of Voting Results on Form 6-K disclosing shareholder approval of two related-party private placements. The company will issue 33,351,853 common shares to Investissement Québec (IQ) and 44,452,460 common shares to Canada Growth Fund Inc. (CGF), both at US$1.84 per share. Disinterested shareholders voted overwhelmingly in favor (over 99.6%). These issuances are structured as private placements under subscription agreements dated April 9, 2026. The transactions are not a tender offer but represent issuer-directed share issuances to strategic investors. Watch for closing conditions and potential dilution impact on existing shareholders.
